verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never states that Poly's source code is published under an open license. The only GitHub item (withpoly/polymcp) describes MCP functionality for listing folders and reading past file revisions. It does not show that the core product source is available, and it names no license. Open-source availability is a fair question for a SaaS file product, so the absence of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
